title: Mahou no Janshi: Poe Poe Poemy
native_title: 魔法の雀士 ぽえぽえポエミィ
overview:
Villains are stirring up trouble, and it is up to the magical girl Poemy to stop them - at the mahjong table. Face each rival in one-on-one riichi mahjong matches, with anime-style scenes telling the story between games. Each win strips an opponent of more of their clothing.

- Story mode with animated scenes
- Free play mode against opponents
- 1 player
